{{quote|Draft a clear plan for constructing the empire, Buildings gain +8% health and +8% work rate for each adjacent similar builing|In-game description}}
'''City Planning''' is a unique [[Technology (Age of Empires IV)|technology]] available to the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]'' that can be researched at the [[House of Wisdom]] (with the [[House of Wisdom#Abbasid Dynasty|Administration Wing]] upgrade) in the [[Feudal Age (Age of Empires IV)|Feudal Age]]. 

After researching it, most buildings within the House of Wisdom [[Influence (Age of Empires IV)|influence]] area gain +8% hit points and +8% work rate for each adjacent identical building. The only buildings that do not benefit are the resource drop-off buildings, namely the Mill, Lumber Camp, and Mining Camp. To be considered adjacent, there must be no tiles separating the two buildings. It is not enough to simply connect the buildings' influence areas (which can still be contiguous even with a 1-tile separation). Tiles connected at corners count as adjacent, making the maximum possible benefit from this boost for any one building +64%. Since [[Farm (Age of Empires IV)|Farms]] and walls do not interact with the influence area, they do not benefit from the bonus. [[Town Center (Age of Empires IV)|Town Centers]] do not distinguish between secondary or [[Capital Town Center]]s for this bonus.

If [[Preservation of Knowledge]] has been researched, this technology costs -20%.
